# SouthBound

> Truck merch and giveaways from @southbound_offical. Shirts, hoodies, caps and decals, with every order entered into the giveaway that is open at checkout. No purchase is necessary to enter; the Official Rules describe the free mail-in entry.

## Pages

- [Home](https://southboundofficial.website/): the current giveaway and the drop by category
- [Shop](https://southboundofficial.website/shop): the drop by category, each with a page of its own: [Shirts](https://southboundofficial.website/shop/shirts), [Hoodies](https://southboundofficial.website/shop/hoodies), [Caps](https://southboundofficial.website/shop/caps) and [Decals](https://southboundofficial.website/shop/decals)
- [Current Giveaway](https://southboundofficial.website/giveaway): the prize and the time left to enter
- [How It Works](https://southboundofficial.website/how-it-works): how an order earns entries and how the winner is drawn
- [Winners](https://southboundofficial.website/winners): every winner and the prize they took home
- [FAQ](https://southboundofficial.website/faq): entries, the free entry by mail, the draw and where giveaways are announced
- [Official Rules](https://southboundofficial.website/rules): eligibility, entry period, how to enter with an order or free by mail, the prize, odds and winner selection
- [Contact](https://southboundofficial.website/contact): reach SouthBound by Instagram direct message
- [Privacy](https://southboundofficial.website/privacy): what the site records and who sees it
- [Terms](https://southboundofficial.website/terms): terms of using the site

## Elsewhere

- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/southbound_offical/): giveaways are announced here first
